arguments.decision_needed: The tenant at Flat 9, 59 Alder Lane reports the LG washing machine supplied with the flat has a power failure and says it can't be repaired (their own web research, not yet diagnosed). They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost, which would remain their property, not part of the flat or inventory, and be taken with them when they leave. Please tell us: (1) do you consent to the tenant fitting their own machine; (2) who pays to disconnect and remove your machine and fit the new one; (3) what should happen to your machine (inspect/repair by us, dispose, or other); (4) may the tenant's machine stay connected. Reply by 2025-07-29.
options: Consent to tenant's own machine; tenant arranges and pays fitting; agency/landlord removes old unit
Our contractor inspects and repairs/replaces the landlord's machine instead

arguments.note: Tenant wants to replace the landlord's LG washer with their own. Needs landlord consent; not a repair. Tenant's machine would stay theirs, not on inventory, taken at move-out. Landlord's machine fate and fitting/removal cost undecided. Fault unverified (tenant googled). Routine.

arguments.body: Hi, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Fitting your own machine needs the landlord's consent, so we've asked them, passing on that yours would stay your property and go with you when you leave. We've also asked who covers removing the old one and fitting the new one, so please don't buy or install anything until we confirm. If you can, a photo of the machine and any error code would help. We'll update you by 29 July.

arguments.decision_needed: The tenant at Flat 9, 59 Alder Lane reports the LG washing machine supplied with the flat has a power failure and says it can't be repaired (their own web research, not yet diagnosed). They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost, which would remain their property, not part of the flat or inventory, and be taken with them when they leave. Please tell us: (1) do you consent to the tenant fitting their own machine; (2) who pays to disconnect and remove your machine and fit the new one; (3) what should happen to your machine (inspect/repair by us, dispose, or other); (4) may the tenant's machine stay connected. Reply by 2025-07-29.
options: Consent to tenant's own machine; tenant arranges and pays fitting; agency/landlord removes old unit
Our contractor inspects and repairs/replaces the landlord's machine instead

arguments.note: Tenant wants to replace the landlord's LG washer with their own. Needs landlord consent; not a repair. Tenant's machine would stay theirs, not on inventory, taken at move-out. Landlord's machine fate and fitting/removal cost undecided. Fault unverified (tenant googled). Routine.

arguments.body: Hi, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Fitting your own machine needs the landlord's consent, so we've asked them, passing on that yours would stay your property and go with you when you leave. We've also asked who covers removing the old one and fitting the new one, so please don't buy or install anything until we confirm. If you can, a photo of the machine and any error code would help. We'll update you by 29 July.
